Roughly 4096 augmentations × (E≈290k relaxations...). From the 2000/32k case: 2000 augs × ~35k edges ≈ 70M relaxations in 12s → ~6M relax/s. Worst case: 4096 augs × 290k edges = 1.19e9 → ~200s. import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from planning import solve
import ipaddress

def big_job(nreq, noff, npairs, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    requests = {}
    for i in range(nreq):
        requests[f'R{i:04d}'] = {'id': f'R{i:04d}', 'at': 10, 'lease': 'L0',
                                 'target': 'x', 'service': 'S0',
                                 'group': rng.choice(['q0','q1','q2','q3']),
                                 'address': 0x20010db8000000000000000000000000 + 1 + i}
    offers = {}
    for i in range(noff):
        offers[f'O{i:04d}'] = {'id': f'O{i:04d}', 'time': 15, 'service': 'S0',
                               'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': 4096,
                               'cost': rng.randrange(0, 10**9), 'group': rng.choice(['p0','p1','p2','p3']),
                               'requests': [], 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32')}
    allreq = sorted(requests)
    # distribute npairs round robin -> many pairs per request
    k = 0
    per = npairs // nreq
    for i, rid in enumerate(allreq):
        for j in range(per):
            offers[f'O{(i*per+j) % noff:04d}']['requests'].append(rid)
    for o in offers.values():
        o['requests'] = sorted(set(o['requests']))
    total = sum(len(o['requests']) for o in offers.values())
    ctx = {'requests': requests, 'offers': offers, 'services': {'S0': 'tcp'},
           'leases': {'L0': {'id':'L0','start':0,'end':100}},
           'request_quotas': {n: {'id': n, 'parent': p, 'capacity': c} for n, p, c in
                              [('q0',None,4096),('q1','q0',4096),('q2','q0',4096),('q3','q1',4096)]},
           'request_paths': {},
           'offer_quotas': {n: {'id': n, 'parent': p, 'capacity': c} for n, p, c in
                            [('p0',None,4096),('p1','p0',4096),('p2','p0',4096),('p3','p1',4096)]},
           'offer_paths': {}}
    return ctx, {r: True for r in requests}, total

ctx, active, total = big_job(4096, 8192, 262144)
print('pairs total', total)
t = time.time()
res = solve(ctx, active)
dt = time.time() - t
print(f'resolved={res["resolved"]} cost={res["cost"]} time={dt:.2f}s')
EOF
